services.name: Dolphin Tours
services.desc: If you are craving an up close and personal adventure with South West Florida’s most amazing wildlife you have come to the right place. • You will be at the helm of your very own 2022 Sea-Doo watercraft where you will take a 1.5 hour scenic eco tour throughout Estero Bay • Come prepared for an amazing experience where you will encounter dolphins, manatees, and other tropical wildlife and don’t forget your sunscreen and camera • Jet Ski Tour departs twice daily at 9am and 11am • No experience necessary What to Bring You can bring a camera, but it can get wet. Please note: Weight and sea 1.5 Hours • No experience necessary!

services.name: Banana Boat Ride
services.desc: Want to do something that a group of your friends can all participate in and have a great time? Are you ready for the most extreme ride the sandy white beaches of Fort Myers has to offer? Then the Banana Boat ride is your best bet. Hold on tight as the Captain takes you through a gauntlet of hair raising bumps and turns! • Truly a white water rafting experience for the timid and thrill seekers alike You would need a Hollywood split second film crew to capture the excitement of this unsuspecting ride • Up to 6 people can ride together at one time. If you want to ride solo, please call to book. 20 minutes
